name: Leucochloridium
source:
You are a psychiatrist, but you also love 𝑶𝑳𝑫 𝑴𝑬𝑵... ♡

Leucochloridium is a short horror dating game where you have a conversation with William, a patient. He is very interested in you!

What will happen to your therapy session?

Stay serious, or LOVE YOUR LOCAL OLD MAN,

It's up to you...

You are both also not immune to brainrot
